games.title: Mướp và Mười Hai Ngọn Đèn
games.blurb: A ginger cat carries the last spark through one long day, from morning hills to an aurora peak, to relight twelve lanterns.

games.title: Tím 4
games.blurb: Notebook pages of a hand-drawn platformer, inked in purple and rebuilt as levels you can really play.

games.title: Line 98: Bảy Sắc
games.blurb: Lines 98, the game of the family computer, by its own rules: move a ball along free squares, put five of a colour in a line and they are gone, and three more come up after every move that takes nothing. It is played in painted places chosen from a map, a land for each colour of ball, where the balls are lanterns, fruit, marbles or planets and move as those do. The rules are the same in every place. In Vietnamese or English.

games.title: Medieval Mayhem II
games.kind: Card battle, you against up to 3 AI rivals
games.blurb: Pick a civilization and outlast the table. Every card is a unit, and everything it does is printed in its symbols.

games.title: Mayhem Classic
games.kind: Card battle, you against up to 3 AI rivals
games.blurb: Four heroes, ten hit points each. Draw a card, play a card, and be the last one standing. Plays by the Dungeon Mayhem rules.

games.title: Masks & Mortar
games.kind: City building with cards, you against up to 7 AI rivals
games.blurb: Each round, secretly take a character, gather gold and build districts. The finest city wins. Plays by the Citadels rules.

games.title: Penned In
games.kind: Pen-and-paper duel, against the AI or a friend
games.blurb: Two markers and a sheet of squared paper. Every mark goes next to your last one and stays in the way for good. Slip through the diagonal gaps, wall off more room than your rival, and don't get penned in.

games.title: Keep It Down
games.kind: Board game of shoves and sieges, against the AI or a friend
games.blurb: Eight Rams a side push across the board. Shove an enemy Ram, or pin it against anything and it is gone. Break through the Gates and bring both Keeps down. But go quietly: take a piece beside a Keep and its bell rings, and the Keep strikes back.

games.title: Keep It Down Extended
games.kind: Board game campaign, you against the AI
games.blurb: Keep It Down with somewhere to go. Around the town, rooms play on after closing, each with its own regulars, from the newcomer to the one who runs the place. You play them for points, and an opponent sits down with you once your points come near hers. They talk while they play, and each keeps an album that fills as you beat her.

games.title: Commander Chess
games.kind: Board game campaign, you against the AI
games.blurb: Cờ Tư Lệnh, Nguyễn Quý Hải’s chess of land, sea and air, played by his own rules. In the officers’ mess at Port Halcyon the officers, from an ensign to the commandant, play you for points: lose your Commander, your last ship or your last plane and the game is over. They talk while they play, and each has cards to win.

games.title: Caro
games.kind: Board game campaign, you against the AI
games.blurb: Five in a row, the Vietnamese way: a line blocked at both ends does not win. Each win develops a frame of your rival’s film.

games.title: Xiangqi
games.kind: Board game campaign, you against the AI
games.blurb: Cờ tướng, the chess of the river and the palace, on a road painted as one long hanging scroll: from Mirror Lake up through the hills to the temple of Cloudrest. Generals keep to their palaces, Cannons take by leaping, and no Elephant crosses the water. Every place on the road is a house with its own way of playing, from the girl who has only just learned the moves to the head of the house. They talk while they play, each keeps an album that fills as you beat her, and each house has a seal to win.

games.title: Wax & Wane
games.kind: Board game campaign of moons that turn, against the AI or a friend
games.blurb: Othello, played with moons. Every disc is a moon, light on one face and dark on the other: enclose the other side’s moons in a straight line and they turn to yours, one after another. The campaign is a crossing of the Moon. On the shore of each of its seas women sit down to play you for points, and every win brings the light further across the map and puts a picture in her album. They talk while they play, each about the way she plays. A friend can sit down too, with nothing at stake. Plays by the rules of Othello.

games.title: Leadlight
games.kind: Lane card battles in stained glass, you against the AI
games.blurb: A card battle at a glazier’s light table, every card a pane of stained glass. Four lanes a side, each laid with a landscape: a creature stands only on a lane of its own realm, buildings stand behind them, spells turn the battle, and each creature has a Glint that costs Light. Every attack goes through the Rose Window, whose brass needle you stop with a tap: on gold to strike, on red to strike twice as hard, and when you are attacked, on blue to block and on red to strike back. The women of the land sit across from you, each with her own deck and her own gift.

games.title: Lantern Line
games.kind: Dots and boxes under sky lanterns, against the AI or a friend
games.blurb: Dots and boxes on a festival night in the Pingxi valley. Draw a line between two dots; close the fourth side of a square and its sky lantern lights in your colour, and you draw again. Ride the line against the computer, on a quick board or a long one, and collect each station’s stamp.

games.title: Lên Đời
games.kind: Turn-based strategy, you against the AI
games.blurb: Medieval empires on a small map. Both sides give their orders in secret, then reveal them at the same moment.

games.title: Ông Trùm 4rum
games.blurb: It is 2007 and you run a fan forum. Clear the spam, calm the drama and keep the boards alive until Facebook arrives.

games.title: Saltline
games.blurb: A first-person shooter in a single HTML file: a container port at dawn, three uplinks of a security net to cut, then the boat. Not a Sonic Hub game: found on the web and kept as a reference for vibe coding. The file names no author.
